description: Performance regression gate on runs measure_performance kept. compare (default): the last runs against baseline and budgets in .appdyno/perf/, failing a change statistically and practically significant. baseline: keeps the last runs (3 needed; replace anew); budget: a kind's max, min. why: a regression's cause by its flow, restarting the app; reference: its baseline side. functions: two cpu ids, from, to. query: a bounded table of a kept trace (read-only sql, table). prune: traces. Returns the verdict.
name: compare_performance
title: Performance baseline and gate
